subject: Northbridge MSA — redline review & onboarding playbook
messages:
From: Samantha Li <sam.li@northbridge.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Northbridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redline + onboarding playbook

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the contract internally and attached our redline (NB_MSA_redline_v3.pdf). We'd like to schedule a 30–45 minute call next week to run through the changes and align on the onboarding playbook so the POC can start on schedule.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Thu Apr 20, 10:00–10:45
- Fri Apr 21, 14:00–14:45

Attendees: Northbridge (Legal + Procurement), Redwood (legal + onboarding/CS). Please let me know who from your side should join and if either slot works.

Attachments: [Attachment: NB_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (PDF, 310KB)]

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
Northbridge Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <sam.li@northbridge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + onboarding playbook

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the quick turnaround and the redline. Laura (legal) and Marissa (onboarding) are looped in.

I can do Thu 10:00 PDT but Laura has a calendar conflict then and suggested a slight shift — Marissa is flexible. If Thu 10 is what works best for Northbridge, we can run without Laura and record; otherwise, can we move to Thu 11:00–11:45 or Fri 11:00–11:45 PDT?

I attached a short draft agenda / onboarding playbook so we can accelerate the call – gives the team context on checkpoints, data handoff, and SSO.

Agenda (draft):
- 5m intro & objectives
- 15m redline walk (Samantha to highlight must-haves)
- 15m onboarding milestones & responsibilities
- 5m next steps / doc/DS sign-off cadence

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-onboard-playbook-v1.docx]

If you prefer, send a DocuSign link and we can start parallel internal review.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0183

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <sam.li@northbridge.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + onboarding playbook

On Wed, Apr 18, 2028 at 11:05 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> I attached a short draft agenda / onboarding playbook so we can accelerate the call 

Thanks, Rishi. I can join but need to shift to Thu 11:00–11:45 PDT due to a conflict with another contract review. If Northbridge can do Thu 11:00, that would be ideal.

To make the call high-value, can Northbridge flag any clauses that are of particular concern ahead of time? High-priority items from our side to confirm:
- Data retention and backup access (section 4.2)
- Audit rights & logs (section 6.1)
- SSO / provisioning timeline (section 7)
- Termination assistance (exit migration scope)

I'll attach a short legal checklist so we can mark items during the call. If you prefer not to share clause-by-clause now, a short list of "must-fix" items is fine.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-legal-checklist.pdf]

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Li <sam.li@northbridge.io>

Thanks, Laura & Rishi. Thu 11:00–11:45 PDT works for Northbridge — confirmed.

I've uploaded an updated redline (NB_MSA_redline_v4.pdf) with highlights for the four items Laura called out (data retention, audit, SSO, termination assistance). Please see pre-read pages 25 for the highlighted language.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode sent to attendees)

Best,

Northbridge Health
